title: Expose authenticated owner inquiry confirmation
requirements: Expose POST /api/v1/admin/inquiries/{inquiry_id}/commands for exactly one accepted command envelope: {type:'CONFIRM', expected_version, expected_visit_versions, payload:{visit_id}}. It adapts the injected AdminCommandRuntime and existing OwnerCommandService.confirm_inquiry; do not add other command types or change the core command contract.

Require a valid owner session, exact trusted Origin, application/json, session-matching X-CSRF-Token and Idempotency-Key before command execution. Preserve the existing administrative boundary semantics: invalid or missing session yields 401 AUTH_REQUIRED, bad origin 403 FORBIDDEN, missing or bad CSRF 403 CSRF_FAILED, and a non-JSON body 415 UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE. Every response has Cache-Control: no-store.

Reject any body other than the strict CONFIRM envelope with 422 VALIDATION_ERROR before delegating, without consuming the idempotency key. On first acceptance return 200 {data:{command_id,inquiry,changed_visits}} from the complete receipt-backed CMD-002 result. An identical accepted replay returns the same data, 200 and Idempotent-Replay: true without a new participation, receipt or audit event.

Map safe command outcomes without diagnostic text: NOT_FOUND to 404, IDEMPOTENCY_MISMATCH, VERSION_CONFLICT, PLAN_CONFLICT and PARTICIPATION_CONFLICT to 409, RESULT_EXPIRED to 410, EXPECTED_VERSION_REQUIRED, INVALID_TRANSITION, VALIDATION_ERROR, OPTION_UNAVAILABLE and other unsupported command input to 422. Malformed inquiry path returns 404.

Add focused route-contract and isolated synthetic PostgreSQL coverage for session/origin/CSRF/media boundaries, strict envelope/type, missing idempotency key, invalid inquiry/visit, missing or mismatched expected versions, incompatible service/duration plan, first confirmation from NEW and NEGOTIATING, complete response, stable replay after later persisted read-model changes, expiry/mismatch, and persistence/audit boundaries. Tests create random disposable databases and never read a local .env or use a configured source database.

Do not add other inquiry or visit commands, manual inquiry entry, payment mutations, notification delivery, catalog changes, production runtime composition, frontend assets, bot adapters, migrations, external calls or secrets.
acceptance: A signed-in owner can explicitly confirm one eligible incoming inquiry into a compatible planned visit and receive the complete documented inquiry result.
Browser-state checks, idempotency, versions and plan validation protect the command before any partial CRM mutation; retries remain stable.
Focused isolated PostgreSQL tests, scope and whitespace checks pass.

shared_paths_approval.reason: Accepted second owner HTTP write endpoint. It exposes only the reviewed confirmation core and complete receipt-backed result behind the established session, origin and CSRF boundary.
